message.content:
Here’s a classic recipe for lasagna:

**Ingredients**

| Category | Item | Quantity |
|----------|------|----------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Lasagna sheets (no-boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1 lb (450 g) |
| | Italian sausage (optional) | ½ lb (225 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 tbsp |
| | Salt | 1 tsp |
| | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | Pinch |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish) | 2 tbsp |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ¼ cup (25 g) |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| | Nutmeg (freshly grated, optional) | Pinch |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 tbsp (60 g) |
| | All-purpose flour | 4 tbsp (30 g) |
| | Milk | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | White pepper | ¼ tsp |
| | Nutmeg (freshly grated) | Pinch |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella cheese | 2 cups (200 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup (50 g) |

Feel free to adjust quantities based on your serving size or personal taste!
